name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
candidate:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  constructor
  · intro s1' htr
    cases hr with
    | choice hbisim =>
      cases htr with
      | choiceL htr =>
        obtain ⟨s2', htr2, hr2⟩ := hbisim.follow_fst htr
        exact ⟨s2', Tr.choiceL htr2, .bisim hr2⟩
      | choiceR htr =>
        exact ⟨s1', Tr.choiceR htr, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    | bisim hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨s2', htr2, hr2⟩ := hbisim.follow_fst htr
      exact ⟨s2', htr2, .bisim hr2⟩
  · intro s2' htr
    cases hr with
    | choice hbisim =>
      cases htr with
      | choiceL htr =>
        obtain ⟨s1', htr1, hr1⟩ := hbisim.follow_snd htr
        exact ⟨s1', Tr.choiceL htr1, .bisim hr1⟩
      | choiceR htr =>
        exact ⟨s2', Tr.choiceR htr, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    | bisim hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨s1', htr1, hr1⟩ := hbisim.follow_snd htr
      exact ⟨s1', htr1, .bisim hr1⟩
